meta.source: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 (as amended up to 24.12.2024)

mandatoryFields.name: Name & complete address of Manufacturer/Packer/Importer
mandatoryFields.notes: For imported goods packed in India, packer/importer's Indian address is also mandatory on PDP. Electronic products may use QR code for address.

mandatoryFields.name: Common or generic name of commodity
Net Quantity
mandatoryFields.notes: Must use SI units only. 'N or U' symbol requirement was removed by 2022 amendment; instead a plain word (number/unit/piece/pair/set) is required. Words like 'minimum', 'about', 'approximately' are prohibited.

mandatoryFields.name: Month & Year of Manufacture
exemptions: warrantied spare parts/accessories not sold to end customer

mandatoryFields.name: Best Before / Use By Date
mandatoryFields.condition: Only required if commodity may become unfit for human consumption over time.
exemptions: governed by another specific law (e.g. FSSAI)

mandatoryFields.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
acceptedFormats: Maximum or Max. retail price Rs./₹ xx.xx (inclusive of all taxes)
MRP Rs./₹ xx.xx incl. of all taxes
mandatoryFields.notes: Must be in Indian currency. Rounding-off provisos were later omitted (now no mandatory rounding rule).

mandatoryFields.name: Unit Sale Price (USP)
notRequiredIf: retail sale price equals unit sale price

formula.byWeight: per gram if net qty < 1kg, else per kg
formula.byLength: per cm if net length < 1m, else per metre
formula.byVolume: per ml if net volume < 1L, else per litre

mandatoryFields.name: Dimensions (where size is relevant)
mandatoryFields.condition: Applies to bed-sheets, towels, sarees, bags/boxes/containers, etc.

ecommerce.requirement: All mandatory declarations except month/year of manufacture must be shown on the digital listing.
ecommerce.marketplaceSafeHarbor: Marketplace e-commerce entities are not liable for declaration accuracy if acting as a pure intermediary under IT Act due-diligence conditions.

exemptions_full_rule26.condition: packed by restaurant/hotel for immediate sale
thread sold in coil to handloom weavers

requiresDisclosure: size in metric or S/M/L notation

exemptions_full_rule26.condition: loose commodities ordered via e-commerce where buyer knows type/quantity

chapterII_inapplicable_to: packages > 25kg or 25 litre (excl. cement/fertiliser bags up to 50kg)
cement, fertilizer, agricultural produce sold in bags above 50kg
commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers
